name: Position Entry
description: Position creation and maintenance data entry widget

getLastEvent.description: Returns the last event generated by the widget.

getActiveTab.description: Returns the currently active tab key: 'create' or 'modify'.

setActiveTab.description: Switches the widget to the specified tab.

getData.description: Returns Tab 1 (Create Position) table data as a JSON string.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Serialized JSON array of row objects.

setCellValue.description: Sets a single cell value in Tab 1.

setRowOptions.description: Sets searchable dropdown options for a Tab 1 cell.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: JSON array of option objects: [{value, text}, ...] or ['value', ...].

getData2.description: Returns Tab 2 (Load / Modify / Delete) table data as a JSON string.

setData2.description: Sets Tab 2 (Load / Modify / Delete) table data.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Serialized JSON array of row objects.

setCellValue2.description: Sets a single cell value in Tab 2.

setRowOptions2.description: Sets searchable dropdown options for a Tab 2 cell.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: JSON array of option objects: [{value, text}, ...] or ['value', ...].

onTabChange.description: Fired when the user switches between Tab 1 and Tab 2. Call getLastEvent() → 'tabChange|create' or 'tabChange|modify'.

onFieldChange.description: Tab 1: fired when any field value changes. Call getLastEvent() → 'fieldChange|rowIndex|fieldName|value'.

onDataEntry.description: Tab 1: fired on data entry, row add, copy, delete, select or clear. Call getLastEvent() for the payload.

onValidate.description: Tab 1: fired when Validate is clicked. Call getLastEvent() → 'VALID|0' or 'INVALID|n'.

onClear.description: Tab 1: fired when Clear clears selected rows. Call getLastEvent() → 'clear|n'.

onSendForApproval.description: Tab 1: fired when Send for Approval is clicked. Call getLastEvent() → 'sendForApproval'.

onFieldChange2.description: Tab 2: fired when any field value changes. Call getLastEvent() → 'fieldChange|rowIndex|fieldName|value'.

onDataEntry2.description: Tab 2: fired on data entry, row delete, select or clear. Call getLastEvent() for the payload.

onValidate2.description: Tab 2: fired when Validate is clicked. Call getLastEvent() → 'VALID|0' or 'INVALID|n'.

onClear2.description: Tab 2: fired when Clear clears selected rows. Call getLastEvent() → 'clear|n'.

onLoadData.description: Tab 2: fired when Load Data is clicked. Respond by calling setData2() with the fetched records.

onSaveChanges.description: Tab 2: fired when Save Changes is clicked. Call getLastEvent() → 'saveChanges|rowCount'.
